title: Review MCP plan
login: Sign in to review this proposal.

fees.title: Fee quote before approval
fees.scope: This cap applies to this approval only, not the conversation total. The displayed server quote is bound to approval.
fees.partial: Only successfully changed selected operations are charged, up to this approval cap. NO_CHANGE and failed operations are free. Cancelling or rolling back later does not refund successful changes.

settlement.title: Execution and settlement
settlement.notFinal: Not final — reconciliation is still pending

execution.HALTED: Stopped by an administrator or security policy

halted: This run was stopped by an administrator or security policy. It will not roll back automatically; use the explicit cancel and reverse-rollback action if needed.

cancel.notice: Cancelling explicitly requests reverse rollback of committed changes. Successful changes remain chargeable.
cancel.confirm: Cancel this run and request reverse rollback of changes already committed? Successful changes will not be refunded.

unavailable.not_mcp: This run is not a server-verified MCP proposal, so it cannot be approved here.
unavailable.missing_authority: The current grant or client authority cannot be verified. Approval is unavailable.
unavailable.unsupported_plan: This proposal is not a valid 1–20 operation MCP plan using the supported document and folder tools.
unavailable.target_version_changed: The document changed. In Claude Code or Codex, read the latest document and submit the edit again. The new proposal must be approved again.
unavailable.quote_unavailable: The server fee quote or registered client name is unavailable. Approval is disabled; refresh the status.
unavailable.quote_mismatch: The fee quote is missing, zero, unsafe, or no longer matches the reviewed plan. Approval is disabled; refresh the status.
unavailable.not_approvable: This run is no longer awaiting approval.

errors.inaccessible: This proposal was not found or is not available to this account and workspace.
errors.credit: There is not enough credit to reserve the maximum charge. Nothing was approved.
errors.conflict: The plan or price changed. The latest status was requested; review it before approving again.
errors.forbidden: Your current workspace or document permission does not allow this action. The latest status was requested.
errors.missing: This proposal is no longer available. The latest status was requested.
errors.price: The server price is not configured, so approval is unavailable.
errors.ambiguous: The server response was unclear. The status was refreshed; do not approve again until the result is shown.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. The latest status was requested.

wiki.title: Review Wiki draft
wiki.origin: Complete draft from an MCP client
wiki.login: Sign in to review this draft.

fees.title: Immutable fee quote before approval
fees.bound: This server quote is bound to this exact draft version, hashes, client, and source mapping. It is not recalculated in the browser.
fees.charge: A published actual change is charged once. NO_CHANGE and unpublished drafts are free. Restoring later does not refund a successful publication.

status.title: Publication and settlement
status.unknown: The publication result is unknown. This is not proof of failure or a free operation; use read-only refresh while reconciliation continues.
status.pending: Settlement is pending reconciliation even if execution has stopped.
status.publishedCharge: The actual Wiki change was published and is charged once. A later restore does not refund this publication.
status.noChange: No Wiki change was published, so the reservation is released without a charge.

wiki.approvalUnavailable: This draft is no longer eligible for explicit approval.
wiki.clientApprovalUnavailable: Trusted registered-client information is unavailable. History remains readable, but approval is disabled.
wiki.cancelConfirm: Cancel this draft execution? Already published changes require the existing explicit restore flow and successful publication is not refunded.

errors.credit: There is not enough credit to reserve the full maximum charge. Nothing was approved.
errors.conflict: The draft, source, public state, or quote no longer matches. Review the refreshed status; a new preview is required before approval.
errors.forbidden: Current workspace or Wiki permission does not allow this action.
errors.missing: This draft expired, was purged, or is not available to this account and workspace. Its cached preview cannot be approved.
errors.tooLarge: The server rejected this preview as too large. No partial preview can be approved.
errors.unavailable: Authorization, pricing, or another required service is unavailable. Approval remains disabled.
errors.ambiguous: The mutation result is unclear. It was not retried; use read-only status refresh until the server reports the result.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. The latest status was requested.
